name: Zingerman's Mail Order
description: Online shop of food and gifts run from Ann Arbor, Michigan. Its customer service page states shipping to all 50 states and Washington D.C., no international shipping, free pickup at its warehouse in Ann Arbor, and local delivery in the Ann Arbor area.

ships_to.notes: Customer service FAQ states food ships to all 50 states and Washington D.C.; Alaska and Hawaii cost extra and take longer; no international shipping.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: FAQ states free pickup of orders at the warehouse, 720 Phoenix Drive, Ann Arbor, MI.

shopping_notes: Site search verified by the probe. Perishable foods ship by expedited service; shipping timing is chosen at checkout.

sources.supports: 50 states and DC, no international shipping, warehouse pickup, Ann Arbor local delivery
online shop of food and gifts
